check_events.outcome: Checked the limited distinction relevant to the D=0 sentence: let A=Q[t]/(t^3-2). The cubic has no rational root, hence is irreducible and A is a field, so Spec(A) is connected. In A, t is invertible because t^3=2; thus 3t^2 is invertible. The monogenic derivative criterion gives a finite étale rank-three cover of Spec(Q). Under its real embedding A lies in R, whereas the other two roots of t^3-2 are nonreal, so A/Q is not normal and is not Galois. This supplies a connected non-Galois finite étale example with empty boundary. It does not prove or disprove the cited 7.1/10.1 proofs, and no theorem of tame ramification or Lefschetz theorem was checked.
